features: Fast Car Charger: Portronics’s Car Power 30, a car charger, delivers fast charging speed through dual ports with a max output of 30 watts, ensuring compatibility with most car models.
Dual Device Charging: The car charger is equipped with powerful dual ports- PD Type-C and USB-A Ports, allowing simultaneous charging of two devices. Charge all your Type C and USB A devices.
BIS Certified Protection: It is BIS-certified to ensure the safe charging of your devices and guard them against, short-circuit, overvoltage, under-voltage, and over-temperature.
Universal Compatibility: This car charger supports USB A and Type C device charging, making it widely compatible with Android, and iOS smartphones, tablets, speakers, earbuds, and more.

Compact and Portable Design: This pocket-sized on-the-go power solution is lightweight and its sleek design fits snugly into car sockets. It is a must-have car accessory for daily commutes or road trips.
Blue LED indicator: A blue LED indicator signals that the Car Power 30 charger is actively drawing power from your vehicle's 12 V cigarette lighter power outlet to charge your devices.
